metadata.methodology: 20 evaluation metrics normalized [0,1], averaged → composite ability, then re-normalized linearly so best model = 1 and worst = 0; Pareto = non-dominated by release date (earlier is better); chart Y-axis (V17): y = 0 at the FIRST (lowest) level of the overall Pareto frontier — models below it are excluded from the chart but kept in the table; chart_y = (ability-y0)/(1-y0); X-axis: linear release-date mapping x = (ts-ts_min)/(xmax-ts_min) (xmax = 11 brand-frontier max); left edge = earliest date in DB; 11 brands get their own thin Pareto lines (brand theme colors, drawn above the solid gray overall Pareto line; vertices ordered by (axis_x, ability) so equal-cost points connect bottom-up); dark brand elements carry a narrow white outline on the black canvas; labels ride ON the Pareto lines when the adjacent segment allows (parallel to the line, mid-axis coincident, line gapped under the text, bare brand-colored text), else take the nearest free spot; every label = model family (brand-shared leading block stripped at the longest valid cut: ending at a separator, or at a letter followed by a digit in every name) plus thinking level, '(non-reasoning)' shortened to '(non)'; 2+ consecutive same-family vertices shorten to level-only labels after the run head (runs recomputed per brand; non-adjacent occurrences keep full labels)

x_axis_mapping.mapping: exp mapping x = (a^(b*t)-1)/(a^b-1), t normalized dates
x_axis_mapping.function: x = (a^(b*t)-1)/(a^b-1) with a=2.2914 b=2.6657 c=0; f(ts_min)=0, f(xmax)=1 exactly; ts>xmax chart-excluded (table x=1.0)

fit.method: least-squares fit of (a,b) over grid (pins exact, c=0)

y_axis.note: chart y = (ability - baseline)/(1 - baseline); models below the first overall-Pareto level are excluded from the chart but kept in the README table
